# JB Decor

> JB Decor is a curtains, blinds and home-décor business in Chidambaram, Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, India. It supplies customised curtains, blinds, mosquito nets, curtain rods, mats, wall décor and interior works, with on-site measurement, in-house stitching and professional installation, backed by 16+ years of experience.

Contact: +91 95248 66006 · jbdecorcdm@gmail.com
Address: 64/82, North Car Street, Chidambaram, Cuddalore - 608 001
Hours: Mon – Sat, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

- [Products](https://jbdecorcdm.com/products): Catalogue of curtains, blinds, mosquito nets, rods, mats, wall décor and more, by category
- [Services](https://jbdecorcdm.com/services): Measurement, stitching and installation, plus false ceilings, modular kitchens and PVC cupboards
- [Portfolio](https://jbdecorcdm.com/portfolio): Completed interiors and projects

- [About](https://jbdecorcdm.com/about): Our story and team
- [Contact](https://jbdecorcdm.com/contact): Call, WhatsApp or visit
- [Book a consultation](https://jbdecorcdm.com/consultation): Request a site visit and measurement
